content.title: How to watch Cubs vs. Phillies: TV channel and streaming options for April 15
content.text: The Philadelphia Phillies and Chicago Cubs play a rubber match on Wednesday at 6:40 p.m. ET, with the series deadlocked at 1-1. Jesus Luzardo (1-2, 6.23 ERA) gets the start for the Phillies, who are 8-9 this season and third in the NL East. Shota Imanaga (0-1, 2.81 ERA) is the expected starter for the Cubs, who are 8-9 and fifth in the NL Central.How to watch Chicago Cubs vs. Philadelphia Phillies Venue: Citizens Bank Park Time: 6:40 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: NBCS-PH and MARQ Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has a 12.5% strikeout rate and a 13.9% walk rate in 72 plate appearances, and he has scored nine total runs. Harper has recorded one steal on two attempts. In 75 plate appearances, Kyle Schwarber has hit six long balls (3rd in MLB), tallied 12 RBIs and scored 12 runs. He is batting .237/.400/.593 and has posted a 34.7% strikeout rate and a 17.3% walk rate. Nico Hoerner is hitting for a .303 BA, .397 OBP and .455 SLG with an 11.5% strikeout rate and an 11.5% walk rate. His OPS is .852 and he has scored 10 runs. In 78 plate appearances, he has hit one home run and driven in 13 runs (20th in MLB). Hoerner has recorded five steals on five attempts. In 70 plate appearances, Dansby Swanson has hit three long balls, tallied nine RBIs and scored 15 runs (5th in MLB). He is batting .164/.329/.345 and has posted a 27.1% strikeout rate and a 20% walk rate. Swanson has recorded one steal on one attempt.
